title: AI tools: overview film
description: 10 tools, with people in charge. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 59 seconds: 10 AI tools for TYPO3 v14, in three groups: AI editors control, checked skills, and agents within limits. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: An AI tool that writes straight to live pages leaves nobody to approve the change.
This lab runs 10 AI tools for TYPO3 v14, and people approve what they change.
The assistant asks before it writes, nr-llm keeps one model setup, and Jev sorts form messages.
Skillflow runs review skills on drafts, and Skillspector checks each skill first.
The MCP Server and the Abilities Registry let agents work within your rules. Agent Nexus shows five protocols, Agentation points at elements, and llms.txt maps the site.
Try the AI tools on your own copy, with people in charge.
